title: mistral-extract-string-parts
request: The Mistral chat model should concatenate plain string parts in a mixed content list. Right now _extract_content_text ignores string entries, so "hello " + {type:'text',text:'world'} returns just "world". Update the method to include string parts.
test_diff:

@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+import pytest
+from browser_use.llm.mistral.chat import ChatMistral
+
+def test_extract_content_text_handles_string_parts():
+    model = ChatMistral()
+    # Simulate a choice dict with mixed content types
+    choice = {
+        "message": {
+            "content": [
+                "hello ",
+                {"type": "text", "text": "world"},
+            ]
+        }
+    }
+    result = model._extract_content_text(choice)
+    assert result == "hello world"
